description: Sends a free, no-obligation quote request for a sauna and/or cold plunge (home or commercial) to Contrast Therapy Finder, which works with manufacturers and gets the person a real quote including delivery and installation requirements. Nobody else contacts them unless they ask. REQUIRED BEFORE CALLING: ask the person for every required detail (never guess or reuse details they did not give for this purpose), show them a summary of exactly what will be sent, tell them Contrast Therapy Finder will share it with a manufacturer to get the quote, and get an explicit yes. Then call with user_confirmed=true and consent=true.

address.description: Optional: delivery street address (manufacturers need it for a delivered price)

agent_name.description: Optional: the assistant or app submitting this

business.description: Optional: business name, for commercial requests

consent.description: The person agreed that Contrast Therapy Finder may share these details with a manufacturer to get their quote

notes.description: Optional: space, number of people, indoor/outdoor, models they like, questions

user_confirmed.description: The person reviewed exactly what will be sent and approved sending it

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code where the equipment will go

name: request_equipment_quote
title: Request a free equipment quote
